0022600183.text: Phoenix hosts Portland in its sixth game of the season, sitting at 1-4 on a three-game losing streak, 12th in the West and 3.5 games behind for third in the Pacific. Portland comes in at 5-1, first in the Northwest, on a two-game winning streak and 4-0 on the road. Mark Williams is out after shoulder surgery, Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, and Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), both out. Portland won the only 2026-27 meeting 124-83 in Portland on October 21, though Phoenix took the 2025-26 season series 2-1.
